visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair and glasses wearing a black button-down shirt stands centrally, holding a blue pen in his left hand and a remote in his right. Behind him is a wide, golden rice field under a bright, overcast sky. To his left, a secondary semi-transparent figure of the same man in a black and white maid outfit stands still. Large black text on a white background occupies the top area. (2) The scene cuts to a digital overlay where three text boxes labeled 'SRAM', 'DRAM', and 'Flash' appear with icons (lightning, fire, warning). The man continues speaking with expressive hand gestures. (3) Transitions show technical diagrams of atomic structures and molecular layouts, specifically referring to SOT-MRAM components. Text overlays shift to scientific terms. (4) A split-screen appears showing thermal imaging charts and data plots with '400 degrees C' mentioned. The man mimics the heat with facial expressions. (5) Charts showing 'Spin-Orbit Torque' performance are displayed. The man points to the data enthusiastically. (6) The man concludes by looking directly into the camera, gesturing with his hands and pen while the background remains the static rice field and the maid-outfit figure.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male narration starts with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. Fast-tempo electronic BGM swells. A 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of the first title. (2) Narration continues with rising intonation patterns. BGM maintains a steady 4-on-the-floor beat. Digital 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of memory icons. (3) Voice pitch remains consistent while speed increases during technical terms. Whoosh SFX transitions between diagram phases. (4) Short stinger-like SFX occurs when the oven/temperature graphics are shown. Vocal intensity increases for emphasis. (5) Rapid-fire narration during the data summary. BGM remains constant but energetic. (6) Final closing remarks are delivered with a friendly, authoritative tone. Music fades slightly at the very end with a final 'ding' UI sound.
